coaching.headline: The team turned 5 of 6 won fights into a prize within 90 seconds, behind Lt. Belica's zero-death damage.

flags.text: Hell of a mid game: Lt. Belica's 27549 hero damage led all ten, with zero deaths against Howitzer.
Ten structures to none: every enemy inhibitor and the Core fell, and no allied tower was lost.
Riktor never died, placed 14 wards and mitigated 23128 damage, both the most of all ten players.
Worst shit stretch: Howitzer killed Khaimera at the pit, Skylar killed Drongo on duo, then enemy Fangtooth.

focus.title: Cash every won fight
focus.action: Keep turning every won fight into the nearest structure. Before an early Fangtooth, Khaimera waits for the duo to join; with the duo down, take Mini Prime or a tower instead.

19.call: Won 3-0: Aurora killed Steel on the duo lane, Drongo killed Rampage at the Fangtooth pit, Fangtooth went allied, then Khaimera killed Howitzer on mid. Drongo razed the duo inner next; repeat that chain.

7.4.call: Two separate plays: Aurora killed Grux on the offlane at the same second Khaimera died at the pit; after Drongo's death the enemy took Fangtooth, then the allies took the offlane outer and Mini Prime.

17.3.call: Two separate plays, both won: a Khaimera kill on Grux, and Lt. Belica and Riktor killing Steel and Howitzer on mid in the allied half; Mini Prime went allied. Sound conversion.

22.7.call: Won 3-0 on mid in the enemy half as Khaimera, Lt. Belica and Drongo killed Skylar, Steel and Howitzer; the duo inhibitor fell in the same window, then the other two inhibitors and the Core.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Three of seven kills landed on Steel, the enemy support. If Steel shows on mid again, start the trade on Steel before Howitzer can answer.
Hero damage ran 1148 per minute against a 736 norm, and 9.3 CS per minute beat a 7.9 norm. Hold that farm pace whenever mid goes quiet.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Objective damage 32381, highest in the lobby, plus the razed enemy mid outer. After a won skirmish, invade the enemy jungle, where Jungle Invasion power doubles.
Two wards placed against a 4.6 norm. If wards were equipped, spend one on the Fangtooth pit entrance before starting each early Fangtooth.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Three of four kills landed on Skylar, with 64% kill participation. When Skylar shows on the duo lane, save the pull for Skylar first.
A rotation kill on Howitzer on mid came right before the allied Mini Prime. Once the enemy duo outer falls, repeat that mid trip before every Prime.
2b90b485-f42a-48a7-808d-18bfb6a27bcf: Razed the enemy duo inner, duo inhibitor and mid inhibitor. When an inhibitor stands open after a won fight, keep finishing structures before chasing kills.
Hero damage 357 per minute against a 694 norm; both deaths came to Skylar on the duo lane. Trade into Skylar once Riktor's pull lands.
20b29f43-52d4-4029-807d-ae93f9f56546: Zero deaths and first blood on Grux, then a second Grux kill on the offlane in the enemy half. When Grux is dead, push the offlane outer right away.
Rotation kills on Rampage on mid and Steel on duo; the Steel kill preceded allied Fangtooth. With the enemy offlane outer gone, rotate to each Fangtooth setup.
CS ran 7.5 per minute against a 9.9 norm. Between rotations, clear the offlane wave before leaving lane.

matchup: Howitzer was the lane opponent: two deaths to Lt. Belica and no kill on Lt. Belica all game.
Howitzer's Land Mine knocks back and briefly stuns; Make It Rain lifts Howitzer skyward to rain missile salvos.
Steel's Force Shield destroys enemy projectiles; aim abilities around the wall.
build: Experimental sim, no recommendation: Combustion opens the sim build; Noxia and Caustica took the Wraith Leggings and Timewarp slots.
Noxia marks heroes on ability damage; a second ability on the marked hero deals bonus max-health damage.
Caustica, finished last, ignores a share of magical armor; earlier fights ran without Caustica.
eternal: Aion stacks mana regeneration on casts and turns spell damage on heroes into gold; Bottomless Vial adds magical power per River Buff.
Vesh, alone past the game floor, is the most played Lt. Belica mid Eternal; Aion sits unranked on a thin sample.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience each second, scaling with hero level.
Combat Veteran and Devastating Bombs are a toss-up in the Lt. Belica mid field; Combat Veteran leads. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active gives a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Epoch is the lone Lt. Belica mid crest with enough games, most played with no edge; Soulbearer is too thin to rank.
improvement: Kit read: Epoch shares the Wizard Crest path, trading Soulbearer's shield and lifesteal for a stasis escape.
No Eternal change is proven: Vesh leads only on games played, with no edge shown.

matchup: Rampage was the jungle opponent: 0/4/2, two of those deaths to Drongo, and no kill on Khaimera.
Rampage led all ten in healing and damage taken; Riktor's Tainted Charm cuts healing of nearby enemy heroes.
Early lane kills landed on Skylar on the duo lane, Grux on the offlane and Howitzer on mid.
build: Overlord cleaves around the basic attack target and stacks permanent health from kills.
Sky Splitter adds a share of the target's current health as on-hit damage, plus lifesteal.
Draconum, finished last, restores health on takedowns; earlier fights ran without Draconum.
eternal: Knell shreds physical and magical armor with Rust stacks; Frequency adds attack speed and ability haste per stack.
Peal adds ultimate haste, and casting Cull makes hits apply maximum Rust stacks briefly.
Thraex is the most played Khaimera jungle Eternal and the sole option over the floor; Knell is unranked.
augment: Jungle Invasion grants physical power inside any jungle, twice as much in the enemy jungle.
In the Khaimera jungle field, Jungle Invasion leads Feral Ambush in a toss-up. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active deals area damage and heals on hero hits, with weaker heals on later hits.
Only Iceskorn Talons clears the game floor among Khaimera jungle crests, most played, no edge claimed; Judgement stays unranked.
improvement: Kit read: Iceskorn Talons shares the Champion Crest path, trading the heal for an ice sheet that boosts allies and slows enemies.
Kit read: Thraex with Savage Strikes and Ferocity, the most played pair, trades armor shred for on-hit healing and attack speed.

matchup: Both enemy duo deaths before minute ten were Skylar's; the allied duo lost Drongo once, to Skylar.
Shock Therapy destroys enemy shields and silences, stripping Steel's passive shield before the follow-up.
build: Dynamo briefly raises damage taken by any enemy Riktor immobilizes, setting up the follow-up burst.
Tainted Charm cuts the healing of nearby enemy heroes and slows, with tenacity for Riktor.
Xenia, finished last, shields allied heroes standing close to Riktor; earlier fights ran without Xenia.
eternal: In the Riktor support field, Krix is the single Eternal with a rankable sample: most played, no edge claimed.
Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the most played Krix pair, the pair run here.
augment: Wanton Warden regenerates health from a share of damage taken, scaling with hero level.
Wanton Warden is the most played Riktor support augment and nothing else has the games to compete, so no edge is claimed.
crest: Leafsong's active speeds nearby allies and makes allies immune to slows; the Visionary passive raises the ward cap.
Sanctification leans ahead of Rift Walkers in the Riktor support field; Leafsong has too few games to rank.
improvement: Sanctification for Leafsong is the field lean on the Warden Crest path: a team shield with tenacity instead of the speed burst.
Krix tops only the games count, so no Eternal swap is proven.

matchup: Skylar dealt 15885 hero damage, the most on the enemy team, and Drongo built no armor.
Skylar's Hypercharge ignores a share of bonus physical armor; Gag Grenade's silence stops Skylar's casts.
build: Experimental sim, no recommendation: Vanquisher matches the sim build; Ruination and Nuclear Rounds took the Deathstalker and Viper slots.
Nuclear Rounds raises ability damage with critical chance, feeding the Wastelander bleed on crits and ability hits.
Ruination drains mana on hit and deals true damage from the mana drained, refreshed by ability hits.
eternal: Fracture raises damage against targets carrying maximum Rust stacks; Frequency scales attack speed with stacks applied.
Weald alone has enough Drongo carry games to count, most played without an edge; Knell has no Drongo carry games.
augment: Shred Spree cuts Shrapnel Cannon's cooldown sharply but halves the damage.
Bring The Boom is the most played Drongo carry augment, with no rival over the game floor; Shred Spree is unranked.
crest: Eviscerator's active empowers basic attacks with on-hit damage and grants attack speed and omnivamp briefly.
Pacifier is the Drongo carry field's most played crest and the only one past the floor; Eviscerator sits below the floor.
improvement: Kit read: Bring The Boom spreads Rad Rounds explosion damage to nearby enemies and keeps Shrapnel Cannon at full damage.
Kit read: Pacifier, on the same Sharpshooter Crest path, trades the attack speed window for a dash and an empowered hit.

matchup: Grux was the lane opponent and went 0/5/0: two deaths to Aurora, two to Khaimera and one to Lt. Belica.
Grux dealt 4505 hero damage, the lowest of all ten, and never scored a kill.
build: Tainted Guard cuts a basic attacker's healing briefly and bleeds the attacker.
Fire Blossom burns nearby enemies each second, ramping while the burn keeps hitting the same target.
World Breaker, finished last, stacks magical damage on hero hits and adds magical power from health.
eternal: Krix adds maximum health and size; Voracity restores health and gold on kills, Feeding Frenzy adds attack speed near enemy heroes.
No Aurora offlane field data exists yet this patch, so no Eternal ranking applies.
augment: Hypothermia makes Boreal Sweep shred physical and magical armor and slow attack speed on enemy heroes hit.
Kit read: with no Aurora offlane augment field yet, the armor shred sets up Lt. Belica's burst.
crest: Tempest's active damages several nearby heroes each second and heals from the damage dealt.
Kit read: Tempest's area damage and healing suit long frontline fights; no Aurora offlane crest field exists yet.
improvement: Kit read: Festering Wounds over Voracity lets Hoarfrost's root cut enemy healing briefly, useful against Rampage, at the cost of kill gold.
No crest or augment change is proven without an Aurora offlane field.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Howitzer Land Mine (knockback), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Riktor) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
ourKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
enemyKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
enemyKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Pounce → Rumble slow → Boulder Throw → Behemoth ult to brawl
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Pounce, grow with Behemoth and out-sustain the fight
enemyKits.passive: ramping health regen for jungle sustain
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he front-lines and CCs
enemyKits.playAgainst: anti-heal and kiting beat his sustain brawl; burst him before Behemoth
